picks.editorial_note: A major AI lab partnering directly with CERN to build a foundation model trained on billions of particle-collision simulations signals a new tier of industry-science collaboration that could reshape how fundamental physics is done.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission connects national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-discovery infrastructure — a flagship federal push that could accelerate research timelines across every national lab and partner university.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 14+ universities pooling advanced computing resources marks a significant regional response to the national AI compute race, with implications for how mid-tier research institutions access capacity typically reserved for elite labs.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federally funded multi-institution effort applying machine learning to protein misfolding could meaningfully advance understanding of neurodegenerative disease, one of medicine's most intractable problem areas.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million NSF-backed robotic cloud laboratory that pairs AI with automated experimentation could dramatically speed the discovery of new quantum materials, a bottleneck field for next-generation computing and electronics.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award for AI-driven optical sensing and imaging reflects deepening defense-sector investment in computational photonics with both military and civilian applications.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: ASU's Intel-backed move to open advanced AI supercomputing to its entire student and researcher population is a notable experiment in democratizing compute access that other universities will likely watch closely.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: Rico Sennrich's ACL Test of Time Award for inventing subword tokenization (BPE) recognizes a foundational technique now embedded in virtually every modern large language model — a rare case of a decade-old academic paper proving to be genuinely field-defining.
picks.title: A Smart Computer

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's work probing internal model activity for warning signs of unsafe behavior, prompted by a real 2026 incident, addresses one of the most pressing open problems in AI safety ahead of further frontier model deployment.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding for an AI platform mapping genetic variants affecting drug metabolism in African patients tackles a long-standing gap in pharmacogenomic research for underrepresented populations, with direct potential to improve treatment outcomes.
picks.title: Google grant boosts UCT's AI-driven scientific breakthroughs
